''See also: [[The Eight-Man Empire Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Eight]]-Man Empire is a powerful organization of wandering conquerors that functions as a collective [[Monarch]]. Rather than following a single traditional [[Path]], the group utilizes the [[Path of the Eightfold Spear]], which is facilitated by eight unique [[Divine Treasure|Divine Treasures]] in the form of intricate golden armor. This specialized equipment creates a spiritual and mental bond between the eight members, allowing them to access each other's powers and share their strength. While each individual member follows their own separate [[Path]], the connection provided by the armor allows them to act with a unified force that can rival or even match the power of a single [[Monarch]]. [[The Empire]] is composed of eight members, typically consisting of [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]], who are supported by several mercenary war-bands such as the [[Ghost-Blade]], [[Flame-Gift]], [[Blood-Chorus]], and [[Nine-Hands]]. These war-bands serve as [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s workforce and provide significant military support, consisting of various ranks including [[Underlord|Underlords]] and Overlords. The golden armor is a vital component of their identity; it can be repaired and passed down to successors when a member dies or ascends, but it cannot be replaced. Because of the immense power granted by their linked armor, the [[Eight]]-Man Empire is highly sought after as a mercenary force, though they command high prices for their services.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Eight]]-Man Empire is a faction composed of four teams from the [[Ghost-Blade]], [[Flame-Gift]], [[Blood-Chorus]], and [[Nine-Hands]] warbands. While the empire maintains control over warlords from the [[Blood-Chorus]], it also features renowned members such as the archer [[Larian]]. During combat events, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] served as a champion for the empire while spectators watched from a dedicated tower. The faction is further distinguished by a plain tower, above which eight gold-armored men and women hover.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Eight]]-Man Empire is a collective of wandering conquerors and a singular [[Monarch]], composed of individual [[Sages]] or [[Heralds]] clad in golden armor. These founding members crafted their eight suits of gold to serve as [[Divine Treasure|Divine Treasures]] that link their wills together. After emerging from a door, the group sought an excuse to intervene in local conflicts, expressing a willingness to support [[Mercy]]'s mother should she emerge victorious. While they are not known for meticulous attention to detail, they provided [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] with a [[Tear of the Deep]] and granted [[Yerin]] mental enhancement after she absorbed one of their thought constructs. Despite their power, [[Kiuran]] suggested that [[Yerin]] possessed the potential to kill the entire empire.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After being addressed by [[Larian]], the [[Eight]]-Man Empire saw its numbers dwindle to only six members before they eventually vanished. Upon their return, the group engaged in spear training and was studied by [[Reigan Shen|Reigan]], who researched their armor to design a specific collar. The empire later fought to hold back the [[dragons|Dragon]] for [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]]'s sake and aligned themselves with [[Lindon]]. During an assault on the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], they utilized the power of all aspects, with [[Larian]] and [[Del'rek|Del’rek]] serving as their representatives.}}
